scope: SnakZap Phase 3 (User Growth) - D07 Personalized Homepage, D17 Trending Now, O02 Group Order, P02 Geo-fence Detection, O12 SnakZap Wallet & Cashback, D03 Spice Tolerance Profile, L02 Pickup Streak Badge, O09 Cart Persistence

functional.evidence: 254/254 tests across 31 files (pnpm vitest run, re-verified live during audit); turbo typecheck 5/5; event catalog test asserts exact 21-event list. Live audit re-runs: cold-start rule_based at 0 orders / ml_weighted at >= 3 (discovery.test.ts:76,97,114); 10-concurrent-add race -> all 10 persist, item_count 10 (groupOrders.test.ts:228-278); Rs 500 order -> 5.00 cashback; 44 m geo update -> within_fence true / auto_checked_in true, 2,102 m ignored; wallet 2.43 credited on pickup (Rs 242.80 order); spice tolerance 2 -> menu returns only Veg Biryani; cart POST/GET/DELETE round-trip with restaurant meta; consumer preview 3000 returns 200.

security.evidence: GET /loyalty/wallet and /loyalty/streak behind authenticate (routes/loyalty.ts:58-76); PUT /users/profile, POST /orders/:id/location-update, and all /cart routes auth-guarded; unauthenticated -> 401. No write API can credit wallet or advance streak: balance changes only via OrderPickedUp domain event with server-side order.user_id (retention.ts:41,45); streak idempotent per server-computed UTC day, gap resets to 1 (loyaltyRepository.ts:212-224). Referral credits gated by 5 fraud checks (valid code, self-referral, already-used, IP, device). Input validation: lat/lng zod range, spice_tolerance 1-5 (400 outside), uuid + quantity 1-99.

performance.evidence: Group-cart per-token async mutex adds O(1) overhead per mutation (groupOrder.ts:67-72); geo-fence O(1) haversine after id lookup; wallet O(1) read with append-only ledger; trending single bounded time+radius pass; cart single Redis set/get with EX; menu spice filter single in-memory pass; consumer cart persist fire-and-forget (non-blocking).

resilience.evidence: Race tests prove zero lost updates under Promise.all concurrent adds (groupOrders.test.ts:228-304); cart expiry dual-enforced by Redis EX 86400 AND read-time guard with injected-clock tests (cartPersistence.test.ts); retention handlers registered independently per event so one failure cannot break the other (retention.ts:176-183); unknown-order/unknown-user paths return clean no-ops/404, never throw.

notes: Demo Razorpay webhook accepts valid_sig_ prefix and Phase-1 vendor status-advance route is unauthenticated - carry-forward accepted note from Phase 1/2 certifications, not a Phase 3 regression; remediation (webhook HMAC with real secret + vendor staff JWT) documented in PHASE_3_AUDIT_REPORT.md section 2.3.
Wallet/streak mutation surface added in Phase 3 is event-driven only (OrderPickedUp); no client-supplied user id or day is ever trusted.
In-memory repositories stand in for Postgres; Drizzle schema migration for Phase 3 wallet/streak/spice/cart columns committed in the corresponding task branch.
